home.heroSub: Calculate both regimes, review every slab, and export an IT-Portal-ready return — private, offline-first, and precise to the rupee.
home.docsDesc: Form-16 and AIS extraction, read by AI and verified by you.
home.aiDesc: Section-wise guidance in your own language.
home.s1d: Both regimes computed side by side — the better one recommended, to the rupee.
home.s2d: Slab-wise breakdown and every deduction accounted for, in full transparency.
home.s3d: An IT-Portal-ready ITR JSON and a signed summary for your records.
home.privacyBody: Everything is encrypted on your device. Documents are destroyed after 24 hours. Your figures never leave your hands without your say.

review.pendingHint: {{count}} warning(s) need your review before you export.

validation.landlordPanRequired: Rent paid exceeds ₹1,00,000/year — landlord's PAN is required.
validation.tdsExceedsSalary: Total TDS across quarters exceeds gross salary — please check the quarterly figures.
validation.deductionsExceedIncome: Total deductions claimed exceed your gross total income — please review the entered amounts.

anomaly.highTds: TDS deducted is more than 50% of your gross salary — this is unusually high. Please verify the quarterly TDS figures.
anomaly.highHra: HRA received is more than 50% of your basic salary — this is unusually high. Please verify with your Form-16.

settings.clearCacheHint: Frees offline app files. Your tax data is kept.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently removes your profile, tax sessions, drafts and cached data from this device. This cannot be undone.

conflict.title: Two versions found
conflict.body: This return was changed on another device. Choose which version to keep — the other will be discarded.

consent.title: Before we begin
consent.body: To prepare your return we will process your PAN, Aadhaar and bank details. Everything is encrypted on this device, documents are deleted after 24 hours, and nothing is shared without your say.
consent.agree: I consent to my tax details being processed on this device.
